name: GPU Volume Kernel Voxelization
definition: A GPU-based voxelization technique that parallelizes the double loop over XY coordinates (previously executed on CPU) using a compute shader kernel named 'Volume'.
summary: GPU Volume Kernel Voxelization accelerates mesh voxelization by parallelizing XY iteration via compute shaders, retaining explicit triangle-voxel intersection logic unlike rasterization-based methods.
